description.value: McDonald's is a global fast food chain with a location in Chilliwack, BC, serving burgers, chicken sandwiches, fries, and McCafé beverages as part of the standard Canadian menu. This location includes a drive-through in addition to walk-in takeaway service. It represents a recognizable quick-service option for cyclists needing a calorie refuel along the Fraser Valley corridor.
